result.stdout:
Eduter CLI
Usage: eduter <command> [bundle-key] [--base-path <folder>] [--target <name>]
Legacy: eduter <bundle-key> <command> [--base-path <folder>] [--target <name>]
Commands:
  AddPages           -ap   Adds pages into the bundle
  AddUKey            -uk   Appends a unique key to the bundle
  build              -b    Builds the bundle package
  ConfigurePublisher -publisher-init Saves the local publisher API connection
  Create             -c    Creates the bundle files
  Help               -h    Shows help for all commands
  Initialize         -init Creates missing metadata for an existing bundle
  OpenPublisherConfiguration -config Opens the local publisher configuration in the default editor
  publish            -p    Publishes the bundle to the target platform
  ResetFileNames     -r    Resets all filenames in the bundle
  Status             -s    Shows the current bundle status
  Update             -u    Displays the command that updates the Eduter CLI
  Validate           -val  Runs validation on the bundle
  Version            -v    Displays the current version
Examples:
  eduter help
  eduter validate MY-BUNDLE --base-path X:\path\to\BundleContent
  eduter MY-BUNDLE publish --target prod --base-path X:\path\to\BundleContent
  eduter publisher init --target prod --api-url https://api.example.com/ --api-key <publisher-key>
  eduter config
Publisher targets are read from %APPDATA%\Eduter\Bundle\publisher.json
